description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP Request class, which is used for representing HTTP requests in a PHP application using the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 package.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implementation of a PSR-7 Request object, encapsulating HTTP method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Request object with specified method, URI, headers, body, and HTTP version.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, such as URI path and query string.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, validating it does not contain whitespace.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used in the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI instance associated with this request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.

methods.name: updateHostFromUri
methods.description: Internal method to update Host header based on the URI's host and port.

methods.name: assertMethod
methods.description: Validates that the HTTP method is a non-empty string.
